note: Loss reflection with explicit role assignments. V6 preserved for rollback.

768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.headline: They took the map. We took the loss.
768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.team: The enemy took every Fangtooth and Prime objective recorded, then dismantled our structures. Our winning skirmishes produced no quick objective return. We could win exchanges, but the enemy kept winning the map.

focus.title: Give the next fight a purpose
focus.action: Before the next objective contest, name the target, the player covering the approach, and the retreat condition. Check afterward whether those assignments happened, not just whether the team got kills.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Wukong brought strong damage and cleared enemy wards with sentry. Keep that denial. Before sweeping for a gank, call the target lane and confirm the laner can follow; before an objective, call the setup and whether the team is contesting or trading. Give the team a plan to respond to, not a fucking guessing game.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Revenant kept the farm and deaths under control, but hero damage fell below his usual output on the hero. A tidy score does not finish the carry job. Keep the discipline; in the next safe firing window, focus on landing the remaining shots before reloading, then reposition instead of forcing a dangerous finish.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett placed plenty of wards and kept deaths low, but recorded no objective damage. Before returning to lane near the next contest, cover a safe objective approach if a ward is available, then prepare the wave so a rotation costs less. Give the team a usable route; chasing a higher ward total is not the assignment.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gideon had the team's most deaths, including one before the late structure losses. For the next contest, hold the escape until the threat is accounted for and agree on a retreat call with Steel before committing. Keep contributing damage, but do not let owning the recommended core become a fucking permission slip to overcommit.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel led mitigation and assists. Keep enabling the team. When the next gank or objective call comes, confirm whether Steel is engaging or holding control to peel, and coordinate the follow-up. Tainted Guard applies healing reduction to an enemy that basic-attacks its wearer; owning it does not mean every enemy being healed is covered.

25.call: Gideon died to Crunch. Two Inner Towers and an Inhibitor fell afterward; event timing alone does not establish that the death caused those losses.

31.call: The final kill sequence ended 1-2 immediately before the Core fell. Kill credits do not establish who was present.

10.7.call: Enemy Fangtooth was taken before the kill sequence began; the subsequent sequence ended 1-4.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Jungle matchup: Yin, with ganks into Gadget, Crunch, and Murdock plus Mourn. This is not a fixed solo lane. Crunch and Mourn finished with armor items, so the target of each gank matters more than whether the build matches a popular list.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: The Perforator gives percentage armor penetration, and Deathstalker adds armor shred through repeated basic attacks on heroes. That combination has a purpose against the armored front line. Deathstalker needs repeated contact; do not assume its full stacked value in a brief gank or assign clone interactions without verification.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Lotus supplies random scaling bonuses rather than a guaranteed defensive response. Early Bloom rewards reaching its level breakpoint; Immaculate protects only while health stays high. Against a setup that chips health before the commit, that protection may be gone before the dive. Keep it for healthy entries, not as a substitute for sustained durability.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Masterful Mimicry adds clone capacity and generates Hair over time. It supports the clone plan, but the match record cannot show clone uptime or how often that extra capacity mattered. There is no basis here to declare another augment a proven upgrade.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Nex stores recent hero damage for its dash burst, so its value depends on the damage window and follow-up target. It fits finishing a gank; it is not a generic defensive answer when committing into several enemies.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: Keep the armor-answering tools when Crunch or Mourn is the reachable target. If those targets cannot be attacked safely long enough to stack Deathstalker, compare a survival slot against it before adding more damage. Decide from the actual threat ending the entry, not simply the count of physical heroes.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Duo lane was Revenant with Steel into Murdock with Mourn. Later fights also included Crunch, whose final inventory added armor and sustain. Mourn finished with Warden's Faith, a direct reduction to critical-strike damage; that gives a concrete reason to inspect target selection and armor answers.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Demolisher addresses physical armor, including additional bonus-armor penetration for attacks and critical strikes. That is relevant into Crunch and Mourn. It does not erase Warden's Faith's separate critical-damage reduction. Terminus supports lifesteal and an overheal shield, but cannot provide that shield without excess healing first.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Vermis needs consecutive attacks on the same hero within its time window. Serration adds missing-health damage to its proc, while Melting Point rewards hitting targets above its armor threshold. Those choices have a plausible front-line purpose; target switches or reload gaps can limit the sequence. Actual proc counts and armor thresholds during fights are not recorded.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Hellfire Blast strengthens the fourth shot and ignores some bonus physical armor on that shot. It fits this armored enemy inventory and reinforces the safe shot-completion takeaway. It does not establish that fourth shots were missed, nor should its armor penetration simply be added to Demolisher as one combined percentage.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Pacifier offers a dash and an empowered physical-damage instance, with extra payoff against low-health targets. Use its movement to preserve a safe firing opportunity as well as to finish. A reset opportunity is not a reason to chase through the enemy team.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: Keep Demolisher in the armor-focused plan. If Mourn's healing or enemy sustain remains the problem on the hero Revenant can safely hit, compare Tainted Rounds for direct anti-heal application, trading a damage or sustain slot rather than blindly replacing the armor answer. Coordinate that purchase with Steel or Gideon; ownership alone does not guarantee coverage.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.matchup: Offlane opponent: Crunch. His final build included Mutilator, Salvation, Draconum and armor, which makes sustained trades and healing reduction relevant. Gadget remained a separate magic-damage threat in team fights; physical armor alone does not answer the full lineup.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Mutilator supplies target-max-health damage through attacks and qualifying ability hits. Tainted Guard brings physical armor and reduces healing on enemies that basic-attack Scarlett, giving it a clear purpose against a trading Crunch. Terminus adds sustain, but the final three-item inventory cannot establish when any of these tools came online.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Knell shreds both armors through repeated hero hits and grants armor from that shred. Peal helps apply maximum Rust stacks after the ultimate; Patina rewards damage-free time with a shield. This favors a prepared entry into an extended exchange. Patina is less dependable during constant chip damage, and the record does not show its shield uptime.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.augment: Volcaic Slam adds a delayed eruption and slow to Empowered Cindara. It offers follow-up pressure if Crunch remains in the eruption area. Its delayed hit is a condition, not guaranteed damage; a movement-heavy exchange may change its value.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.crest: Liberator provides a cleanse and short shield, a defensive purpose that can matter when control prevents an exit or follow-up. The record does not identify which debuffs were cleansed or whether the active was available at a death.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.improvement: The existing Knell and anti-heal plan fits the Crunch matchup. If repeated immobilization is the real obstacle, compare Resonant Repair against Peal at draft time: defensive recovery and tenacity versus faster Rust application after the ultimate. Do not replace the whole build just because objective damage was low.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Mid opponent: Gadget. Her final build included Soulbinder for long-range ability pressure, Megacosm for health-based damage and Entropy for additional ability-hit damage. Crunch's later armor and health items also change the targets available in team fights; lane and late-fight needs are different.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Azure Core stacks mana and grants mana-scaling power when those stacks are complete, alongside a low-health shield; Combustion adds ability-hit burst, while Wraith Leggings rewards damage into low-health heroes. That is an offensive package, not a dedicated answer to Gadget's pressure. The final inventory does not tell us Azure Core stacks or whether its shield was ready when Gideon died.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh extends ability damage with a DoT. Tithe of Death rewards takedowns with mana and haste; Phylactery adds post-ultimate cooldown progression and a mana-based shield. That works with a mana investment, but the protection has a trigger and window. It does not prove the ultimate was safe to commit or completed.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Event Horizon adds target-max-health damage to center hits of Cosmic Rift. Crunch and Mourn's health investments give that effect a matchup purpose. Landing the center is essential; the feed cannot score those hits or prove another augment would have performed better.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Soulbearer adds a mana-scaling shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed during its active window. It complements the mana package and offers a planned defensive window, but it does not make enemy control irrelevant or prove correct active use.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: If the team cannot keep healing reduction on a reachable target, compare Tainted Scepter against a damage slot such as Wraith Leggings: direct magical-damage application versus low-health finishing damage. If Gadget's pressure is instead preventing contribution, prioritize a defensive comparison. The death count alone cannot decide which problem caused the loss.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.matchup: Support lane was Steel with Revenant into Murdock with Mourn. Crunch and Yin added later physical threats, while Gadget supplied substantial ability pressure. Build decisions should distinguish protecting Revenant from surviving an engage, rather than treating every tank item as interchangeable.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Xenia shields nearby allies, so its support value depends on proximity. Dynamo creates a short damage-amplification window after immobilizing an enemy, rewarding coordinated follow-up. Stonewall and Tainted Guard favor physical durability; Tainted Guard only applies anti-heal to enemies that basic-attack Steel, not automatically to everyone Mourn heals.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Krix increases maximum health, which also supports the health scaling on Xenia and Sanctification. Cannibalism rewards takedowns with more health. Regenerative Tissue favors recovery outside hero damage; Festering Wounds is a meaningful draft alternative when Steel needs to apply anti-heal through immobilizing effects instead of waiting to be attacked.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.augment: Heavy Metal adds damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor. The armor purchases therefore have an offensive interaction as well as a defensive one. That synergy does not prove the hits landed or justify ignoring Gadget's damage type.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.crest: Sanctification shields Steel and nearby allies, granting tenacity while the shield holds. It supports a planned group commitment or peel. Neither the final inventory nor mitigation totals show whether allies were in range or the active was used at the useful moment.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.improvement: At draft time, compare Festering Wounds with Regenerative Tissue if reliable healing reduction is Steel's job. During the match, if Gadget is the threat forcing Steel out, compare magical defense before another physical-only purchase. Preserve Dynamo's follow-up plan and Xenia proximity; do not assume two Tainted Guards guarantee coverage on the team's chosen target.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.note: The user confirmed Wukong ran sentry in this losing match.

768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.lossReflection: The stronger alternative was to set up before the next objective. Send the nearby laner to prepare the wave and cover a safe approach, have Wukong communicate the gank or objective plan before sweeping, and confirm who can follow. If the approach is unsafe, call a reachable trade or defend together. Winning a skirmish is not a fucking shopping receipt for an objective; someone still has to call what is safely available.

0b5db31c-78f7-4194-814c-824348b60836.headline: The kills were there. The finish was a fucking mess.
0b5db31c-78f7-4194-814c-824348b60836.team: We took every recorded Fangtooth and still lost the base after the late wipe. Friends reported kill-chasing for fun and Kwang diving towers; that describes a very different problem from missing damage. The team had enough output to threaten this game. The closing deaths and collapsing structures are the part that actually settled it.
0b5db31c-78f7-4194-814c-824348b60836.lossReflection: The alternative was to turn the Fangtooth gains into a controlled push: fix the waves, keep GRIM and Wraith able to hit, and make Serath come through Aurora and Kwang. When a defender retreats under a tower, take the space or the structure if the wave allows it, then reset. The reported chase habit needs a stop call, not another damage item. This would give the team a cleaner chance to close, not guarantee the win.

focus.title: Call the prize, then stop
focus.action: After the next won exchange, name the safe objective or wave to take and the reset point. Anyone asking for a tower dive must name the wave, follow-up and exit first. No plan, no dive.

playerTestimony.note: Friends reported that Kwang was suicide bombing towers and the team was chasing kills for fun. This is reported behavior and intent, not telemetry or replay verification; no counts or timestamps were supplied.

b449674d-1061-4984-b85e-5acf60f0d620.note: Reported tower dives described as suicide bombing.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: GRIM supplied kills and objective damage while keeping his deaths down. Keep that useful output. When Serath disappears, save Pacifier for separation and keep Energy Shield ready for the ability that would pin him down. A fleeing Belica is not worth handing Serath a stationary carry. Take the reachable target and stay available for the push.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase supplied substantial healing and placed more wards than his usual on the hero. Keep that support work. When the team starts chasing, stay in a position to pull GRIM back toward safety rather than following the deepest diver. Call the pull before he is immobilized, because Link cannot rescue him once that lands. A support buff is not a shared suicide pact.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Aurora farmed and dealt damage above her usual, while leading our objective damage. Keep that engine running, but give the team a target and an exit before committing. When Serath dives GRIM, use the root to buy shooting time rather than automatically chasing their retreating backline. This team already had people willing to go forward; it needed a clear reason to stay or leave.
perPlayer.b449674d-1061-4984-b85e-5acf60f0d620: Kwang led our damage and our deaths. The reported tower dives need to stop: topping the damage chart does not make that shit a good trade. Before going under a tower, confirm the wave, allied follow-up and a way out. Otherwise hold the sword threat, protect the hitters and let the structure be the target. Keep the damage, lose the donation habit.
perPlayer.6ea14df4-52f3-463b-9d1f-2e42d2fff0ac: Wraith contributed to both hero and objective damage. Keep the ranged pressure, and make the next shot support the team call. When a marked target retreats beyond the safe push, stop following and cover the approach with Sonar instead. Save camouflage for repositioning when Serath closes. The useful finish is a surviving shooter beside a falling structure, not a stylish kill after the base is already collapsing.

24.4.call: This kill sequence went 1-5 after Kwang had already died shortly before it. That establishes costly overlapping deaths, not the local numbers at the start of a fight. With an ally unavailable, the default call should be to catch safe waves and preserve the next defense unless a clear, reachable advantage appears.

28.9.call: The 0-5 sequence was followed by the inner towers, inhibitor and Core falling. The priority at this stage is keeping wave clear and sustained damage alive. Back away from an unfinishable target and defend the route to the base; the record does not establish which player started the fight.

30.2.call: Two enemy kills landed while the Core fell in the same window. That is why the target call must include the base state: kill the threat that stops the defense, not simply the easiest hero to finish. The event log cannot show whether these particular kills could have saved the Core.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Duo was GRIM and Phase against carry Belica and support Valmont. Belica ran Sky Splitter, Scattershot, Tainted Rounds and Demolisher with Pulsefire Rounds: treat her as a basic-attack threat with mixed damage, not a conventional mage just because of her hero name. Serath's undefeated jungle game made access to GRIM the other major concern.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Lightning Hawk rewards moving and attacking with a slowing hit; Plasma Blade and Dust Devil build their bonuses through hero attacks. Nuclear Rounds boosts ability damage through critical chance. Tainted Rounds gives GRIM his own healing reduction against Serath and Terra. The package rewards sustained firing; it does not fix losing access to safe targets.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Weald rewards hitting low-health heroes, Forage pays for farming, and Wind-Rider grants attack speed after mobility such as Pacifier's dash. It is coherent with a carry who wants to finish targets. Natural Resistance is a draft alternative to Forage if getting controlled is the main problem, trading farm income for a low-health defensive trigger rather than more finishing damage.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: System Restore rewards successfully blocking an ability with Energy Shield with healing and movement speed. That is relevant against Belica's control and the enemy follow-up. It only pays when an ability is actually blocked, so keep it as a defensive choice without claiming it saved particular fights or covered basic attacks.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Pacifier supplies repositioning and a kill-reset opportunity. Its empowered damage is tied to a physical-damage instance, while GRIM's passive converts his basic attacks to magical damage; do not count that bonus as automatic value on his normal shots. The dash still has an explicit purpose against Serath and can trigger Wind-Rider. Actual active use is not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: If diving pressure is ending firing time, compare a defensive crest choice at evolution rather than simply adding more damage. Keep Tainted Rounds when GRIM needs independent anti-heal coverage; Phase's Totem can also grant it through healing, but that coverage is not guaranteed at all times. The current damage package is not proven to be the cause of this loss.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Against Belica and Valmont, Phase has to account for both ranged pressure and Belica's immobilize. Serath and Terra add close-range threats later. Valmont's Tainted Scepter and Belica's Tainted Rounds can reduce healing, so health restoration alone cannot substitute for spacing and timely rescue.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Marshal buffs nearby attackers and Tainted Totem passes healing reduction to allies Phase heals or shields. Prophecy and Spectra instead reward Phase landing repeated basic attacks herself. Those are different jobs competing for her attention: empowering GRIM is valuable even when stepping forward for personal on-hit damage is unsafe. None of these completed items supplies armor.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Exarch gives healing and shielding an offensive reward for their recipients. Preservation increases healing or shielding Phase receives; Fervour adds nearby healing when she basic-attacks heroes. The loadout supports the existing on-hit plan, but Fervour does not justify walking into Serath's reach. Exarch fits this support plan; the key question is whether Phase can safely maintain its useful support triggers.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Psychic Support restores a linked ally's missing mana through Essence Catalyst. That has a clear role for GRIM, whose Assault Mode spends mana, and for other spell users. Keep it if linked allies need that resource; Kindred Surge is a draft alternative for movement and regeneration during Hyperflux, giving up this mana support.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Tranquility provides nearby healing and brief mitigation, plus support vision capacity. It suits protecting the group rather than chasing a separate target. Enemy healing reduction pressures the heal component, while the brief mitigation still has a distinct purpose. The record does not tell whether Grace was available during the closing sequence.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: Enra's Blessing over Spectra is the clearest protection comparison if GRIM is being immobilized nearby: it exchanges Phase's personal on-hit damage for an automatic ally shield on that trigger. Galaxy Greaves is another defensive direction if Phase herself cannot survive the approach. Neither purchase excuses the reported chase pattern; the choice should follow who needs protection and from what.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.matchup: Serath was the opposing jungler, with repeated basic-attack damage, sustain and a low-health Salvation shield. Belica's carry build adds another sustained attacker, while Terra can cleanse debuffs with her ultimate. Aurora should not assume every root will stop Terra during her defensive tools, or that a low-health Serath is already finished.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Spirit Of Amir supports monster damage and gives location-dependent bonuses. Magnify reduces magical armor through ability damage; Spectral Schematics and Dynamo reward immobilizing a target. Elafrost adds a slowing empowered attack after casting and physical armor. The synergy is real when control lands, but cannot be credited on every spell or against a target that was not immobilized.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Lotus accumulates random bonuses. Flawless heals nearby allies on an ability hit against a hero, once per cast, and Fragrance improves damage against nearby heroes. That fits close-range spell fighting. Immaculate is a defensive draft alternative to Fragrance, trading close-range damage for mitigation near full health; it is not protection that stays active throughout a long brawl.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.augment: Glacial Thorns makes Glacial Charge leave damaging, rooting crystals at its base. This gives the movement spell a useful control function and a potential trigger for the immobilization items. Keep it for approaches and disengages, without assuming every crossing enemy was rooted. Deep Freeze instead widens the ultimate area, trading this additional route control for ultimate coverage.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.crest: Tempest rewards remaining near enemy heroes with damage and healing. That matches Aurora's brawling range, but Valmont and Belica have healing reduction and Serath can punish a prolonged stay. Its value depends on reachable targets and survival through the duration, not merely on pressing it at the start of an engage.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.improvement: Keep the control package unless the actual problem is dying before it can work. If repeated incoming damage prevents a second spell rotation, compare a defensive slot against Spectral Schematics' extra damage. Elafrost already supplies physical armor; any further defense should account for Belica's mixed build and Valmont, not blindly follow the hero-class damage labels.

b449674d-1061-4984-b85e-5acf60f0d620.matchup: Terra's offlane build combines sustain, health and both armors through Vainglory. Her ultimate cleanses debuffs and adds defenses, so she is not an easy permanent tether target. Across the match, Serath brings sustain and a low-health shield while Belica's attack build and Valmont punish an extended exposed approach.
b449674d-1061-4984-b85e-5acf60f0d620.build: Magnify and Megacosm help Kwang work through resistant, high-health targets such as Terra. Tainted Scepter reduces healing on magical damage; Orion turns Ability Haste from items into attack speed and rewards repeated hits on the same target. This is an extended damage plan. It carries health but no flat armor item, and does not turn a tower dive into a safe commitment.
b449674d-1061-4984-b85e-5acf60f0d620.eternal: Knell shreds both armors through attacks and abilities and grants a share of the armor removed. Frequency rewards applied Rust stacks with attack speed and haste; Fracture increases damage against fully stacked targets. It suits sticking to one reachable opponent. Those bonuses require hero contact and buildup, so they should not be treated as unconditional durability against tower fire.
b449674d-1061-4984-b85e-5acf60f0d620.augment: Aura of the Heavens grants personal omnivamp and a smaller nearby ally benefit. This favors fighting close enough for teammates to use the aura. Belica and Valmont can apply anti-heal, and the aura is sustain rather than permission to ignore burst or tower damage. Keep the team value without claiming it offset the reported dives.
b449674d-1061-4984-b85e-5acf60f0d620.crest: Tempest adds nearby damage and healing during its active window. It aligns with Kwang's brawling build, but extending a dive just to continue the aura exposes him to more damage. The match does not record its activations, and the friends' account does not establish whether it was available for any particular tower dive.
b449674d-1061-4984-b85e-5acf60f0d620.improvement: If Kwang cannot survive the first exchange with Terra or Serath, compare a defensive item against Orion's attack-speed and ramping-damage slot. Vainglory supplies both armors and builds more during hero combat, but gives up Orion's offensive contribution. That is a conditional build adjustment; the first correction to the reported tower dives remains choosing a survivable commitment, not buying an excuse to repeat them.

6ea14df4-52f3-463b-9d1f-2e42d2fff0ac.matchup: Wraith's listed mid opponent was Renna, who finished with little recorded damage and only Entropy. That does not prove why her impact was low. Later threats were much clearer: Serath could reach a ranged shooter, Terra had both armors, and Belica was their highest total damage dealer with a carry build.
6ea14df4-52f3-463b-9d1f-2e42d2fff0ac.build: Soulbinder rewards long-range ability hits; Mystic Marksman makes the sniper shot magical, so Tainted Scepter and the magical penetration from Wraith Leggings have a coherent target. Noxia needs damage from a separate ability after the initial mark, not repeated casts of the same shot. This is a spell-combination build, not evidence that every long shot applied every passive.
6ea14df4-52f3-463b-9d1f-2e42d2fff0ac.eternal: Lotus gives random permanent bonuses, Early Bloom grants an extra level on reaching its threshold, and Immaculate reduces damage while near full health. That suits a ranged plan that tries to avoid the first hit. Once poked below its threshold, Immaculate stops supplying that protection; it cannot be assumed to cover a full Serath dive.
6ea14df4-52f3-463b-9d1f-2e42d2fff0ac.augment: Mystic Marksman changes Knock, Knock! to magical damage, which explains the power and penetration choices. It also makes enemy magical armor more relevant to the shot, including Terra's Vainglory. Keep the coherent conversion rather than judging this inventory against a physical Wraith template. The record cannot establish shot accuracy or how many marked combinations landed.
6ea14df4-52f3-463b-9d1f-2e42d2fff0ac.crest: Epoch provides stasis, a tool to wait out incoming danger while teammates reposition. It supplies no escape distance, so it needs a survivable position afterward. Against Serath, holding it for a dangerous commitment is a defensive plan; nothing in the event log proves whether Wraith mistimed or used it in the closing fight.
6ea14df4-52f3-463b-9d1f-2e42d2fff0ac.improvement: There is no automatic need for another offensive item.
